abstract.text: Group the Routes for a person or team within an Activity.

inlineContent.text: While the Activity is in Planning and you have permission to edit it:
Select the Routes for the person or team. The list shows Routes that are not already assigned.
An Assignment can include several Routes. Prepare these connections before starting the Activity; starting locks the plan.

To change a Planning Assignment, open its More menu, choose Edit, update its name or selected Routes, then Save. Routes already given to another Assignment are unavailable. Cancel leaves the saved plan unchanged.
An Assignment organizes the work. To give someone access to it, share the Project and Activity with them; see
In an active Activity, tap Assignments and choose an Assignment. Open Routes and choose a Route to see its Stops. The map shows the work you open in the Console.

The active Activity can transfer Items to this Assignment. Its Resources show what remains available for delivery or further transfer. Tap Record Item Transfers to return unused Items to the Activity or transfer them to another Assignment in the same Activity. See
for the Review and Save steps.

content.text: Review results and share a report

inlineContent.text: Open an Assignment in an Active or Ended Activity.
Tap Copy to copy the report text, or Share to choose a destination.
Use Refresh to update the preview. Report Settings lets you adjust its presentation. You can also open Settings from Projects and choose Report Style.
Active Assignments show compact saved progress. Ended Assignments provide usage and distribution results and read-only Route details. See
for graphs, report templates, and display options.

abstract.text: Keep your places together, plan team work, and follow service and Item deliveries.
Plan one round of work, follow it, and keep its history.
Record Supply, give Items to teams, and return or transfer their remaining quantities.
Review saved service and Item deliveries, then prepare an Assignment report.
